notes: The target MvPowerSeries.pderiv takes the coefficient ring implicitly, so pderiv A i becomes pderiv (R := A) i throughout, including in theorem statements. The definition of pderiv is otherwise identical in the pinned and target Mathlib (only `variable (R) in` was dropped), so these are the same terms and the statements are unchanged in meaning. In one proof, IsAddTorsionFree.of_module_rat now produces HasUniqueDiv (the pinned meaning of IsAddTorsionFree), so the local instance is stated as HasUniqueDiv A. The statements keep [IsAddTorsionFree A]; since A is a CommRing, the target IsAddTorsionFree is equivalent to the pinned one (n • · injective for n ≠ 0).
